name: WGPT
fix_description: In callPrice(), do not use instantaneous balanceOf(swapLPAddr) to calculate LP price. Use TWAP or internal accounting to prevent flash-loan manipulation of the pair token balance.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step exploit involving five nested flash loans, interaction with a Pancake pair/router, and understanding a broken token fee mechanism via repeated skim abuse. While the core bug is not deeply complex, writing the PoC requires protocol-specific reasoning about AMM reserve syncing/skimming and coordinated liquidity usage, putting it above a simple one-step exploit.
